names.posthumous: 体神合道骏烈逊功圣文仁德慈宪显孝皇帝

summary: 一代艺宗，瘦金体冠绝古今，而蔡京当国、花石纲乱政，终致靖康之祸。
summary_en: An artistic genius whose slender-gold calligraphy crowned the age, he let Cai Jing dominate the court and the Flower-and-Rock Network ravage the land, ending in the Jingkang catastrophe.

portrait.appearance_basis: 传统画像符号化描写居多。图像为依时代冠服所作的 AI 艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 神宗第十一子，封端王，长于书画。
timeline.summary_en: Eleventh son of Shenzong, enfeoffed Prince Duan, versed in painting and calligraphy.

timeline.title: 即位
timeline.summary: 哲宗崩，向太后立端王佶。
timeline.summary_en: On Zhezong's death Empress Xiang raised Prince Duan to the throne.

timeline.title: 蔡京当国
timeline.summary: 用蔡京为相，立元祐党人碑，兴花石纲。
timeline.summary_en: He made Cai Jing chancellor, erected the Yuanyou partisans' stele, and launched the Flower-and-Rock Network.

timeline.title: 方腊起义
timeline.summary: 睦州方腊起事，东南震动，花石纲为民怨之由。
timeline.summary_en: Fang La rose in Muzhou and shook the southeast, driven by grievance over the Flower-and-Rock Network.

timeline.title: 内禅
timeline.summary: 金兵南下，禅位太子桓，称太上皇。
timeline.summary_en: With Jin troops approaching he abdicated to his son and became retired emperor.

timeline.title: 崩于五国城
timeline.summary: 靖康二年被掳北迁，绍兴五年崩于五国城。
timeline.summary_en: Taken north in the Jingkang disaster, he died at Wuguocheng in 1135.

timeline.title: 书画
timeline.summary: 擅书画，创瘦金体，建宣和画院，艺术成就冠绝帝王。
timeline.summary_en: A master of painting and calligraphy who created the slender-gold script and founded the Xuanhe Academy, unrivalled among emperors in art.

relations.note: 哲宗弟，元符三年向太后立之
relations.note_en: Emperor Zhezong's younger brother; in the third year of Yuanfu, Empress Dowager Xiang enthroned him

relations.note: 宣和七年金兵南下，内禅太子桓
relations.note_en: In the 7th year of Xuanhe, with Jin forces marching south, he abdicates within the family to the heir apparent Huan

relations.note: 联金灭辽，燕云终成引狼入室之局
relations.note_en: Allies with Jin to destroy Liao; the Yan-Yun region ends as a case of inviting the wolf into the house

meta.inclusion_reason: 北宋第八位皇帝，正史立纪。

bio_md:
# 宋徽宗 · 主要事迹

赵佶为[[n-song-shen|神宗]]第十一子，元符三年（1100）即位。他是中国帝王中最杰出的艺术家之一：瘦金体书、花鸟工笔、宣和画院，艺事冠绝一代；但作为皇帝，其政绩却是北宋亡国之由。

崇宁元年（1102）任蔡京为相，立元祐党人碑，禁锢旧党；「花石纲」搜罗东南奇花异石，民怨沸腾。宣和二年（1120）方腊起于睦州，东南大震。外交上徽宗联金灭辽，宣和五年（1123）收回燕京空城，纳岁币而开衅端，实为引狼入室。

宣和七年（1125）金兵南下，徽宗仓皇内禅太子赵桓，称太上皇，是为[[n-song-qin|钦宗]]。靖康二年（1127）二帝被掳北迁，徽宗绍兴五年（1135）崩于五国城（今黑龙江依兰）。

bio_parts_en.value:
, ascended in 1100. He is among the greatest artists ever to sit on a Chinese throne: the slender-gold calligraphic script, bird-and-flower painting, the Xuanhe Painting Academy - his artistry crowned the age. As an emperor, however, his record is the ruin of Northern Song.

In 1102 he made Cai Jing chancellor, erected the stele proscribing the Yuanyou faction, and launched the Flower-and-Rock Network that stripped the southeast of its finest stones and plants, breeding seething resentment. In 1120 Fang La rose in Muzhou and shook the southeast. Abroad he allied with the Jin to destroy Liao, recovering the empty city of Yanjing in 1123 on tribute terms - in reality inviting the wolf into the house.

In 1125, with Jin armies advancing, Huizong abdicated hastily to his son Zhao Huan,
, and became retired emperor. In 1127 both emperors were seized and taken north; Huizong died at Wuguocheng in 1135.
